recent_en: L&P Global recently announced diversification into FMCG and construction, and secured building contracts worth approximately RM11.76 million through its subsidiaries. The company also proposed the disposal of a leasehold land and buildings in Kedah. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue fell 22.0% year-on-year but net profit turned to RM3.901 million.
notable_en: Secured building contracts worth RM11.76 million.
Proposed diversification into FMCG and construction.
Proposed disposal of a leasehold land and buildings in Kedah.
risks_en: The company has been buying back its own shares.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM14.896 million, down 22.0% year-on-year and 1.4% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM3.901 million with a net margin of 26.2%, turning positive from -8.1% in the previous quarter.
